system.description:
Wit; no damage (N/A); Medium (50 ft). Obscure: smoke surrounds you for 2 Combat Rounds. You may Escape a Brawl at once with no penalty. Each enemy within 50 ft (Medium) must pass a CR 2 Wit Check or be Blinded until the start of your next Combat Turn. While inside the cloud you are Steeled and in Stealth.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.148

automation.note: Obscure: don't Strike with it. Post the Smoke Bomb to chat, target the enemies within 50 ft and use its buttons: they save or are Blinded, and you gain Steeled and Stealth for the cloud's 2 Combat Rounds. You may Escape a Brawl at once with no free attacks against you. Remove Steeled and Stealth early if you leave the cloud, and mark the bomb as used.
